parts.article_title: Is Your Child at School Today?

paragraphs.text: School Attendance Information for Parents/Carers
paragraphs.translation: 家长/监护人出勤信息

paragraphs.text: Introduction
paragraphs.translation: 引言

paragraphs.text: Receiving a good full-time education will give your child the best possible start in life. Attending school regularly and punctually is essential if children are to make the most of the opportunities available to them. The law says that parents must ensure that their child regularly attends the school where he/she is registered.
paragraphs.translation:
接受良好的全日制教育将为您的孩子提供人生中最佳的开端。
如果孩子们要充分利用现有机会，定期且准时上学至关重要。
法律规定，父母必须确保其子女定期就读于他/她注册的学校。

paragraphs.text: What you can do to help
paragraphs.translation: 您可以采取哪些措施提供帮助

paragraphs.text: • Make sure your child arrives at school on time. This encourages habits of good timekeeping and lessens any possible classroom disruption. If your child arrives after the register has closed without a good reason, this will be recorded as an 'unauthorised' absence for that session.
paragraphs.translation:
• 确保您的孩子按时到校。
这有助于养成良好守时的习惯，并减少可能对课堂秩序造成的干扰。
如果您的孩子在点名结束后无正当理由才到校，该时段将被记录为‘未经批准的’缺勤。

paragraphs.text: • If your child has to miss school it is vital that you let the school know why, preferably on the first morning of absence. (Your child's school will have an attendance policy explaining how this should be done.)
paragraphs.translation:
• 如果您的孩子需要缺课，您务必告知学校原因，最好在缺课的第一天早上就通知。
（您孩子的学校会有一份出勤政策，说明应如何通知。）

paragraphs.text: • If you know or think that your child is having difficulties attending school you should contact the school. It is better to do this sooner rather than later, as most problems can be dealt with very quickly.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你知道或认为你的孩子在上学方面有困难，你应该联系学校。
最好尽早这样做，而不是拖延，因为大多数问题都可以很快得到处理。

paragraphs.text: Authorised and Unauthorised Absence
paragraphs.translation: 准假与未准假缺勤

paragraphs.text: If your child is absent and the school either does not receive an explanation from you, or considers the explanation unsatisfactory, it will record your child's absence as 'unauthorised', that is, as truancy.
paragraphs.translation: 如果您的孩子缺课，而学校要么没有收到您的解释，要么认为解释不充分，学校会将您孩子的缺课记录为“未经授权”，即旷课。

paragraphs.text: Most absences for acceptable reasons will be authorised by your child's school:
paragraphs.translation: 大多数因合理原因造成的缺勤将获得您孩子所在学校的批准：

paragraphs.text: • Sickness
paragraphs.translation: • 生病

paragraphs.text: • Unavoidable medical or dental appointments (if possible, arrange these for after school or during school holidays)
paragraphs.translation: • 不可避免的医疗或牙科预约（如果可能，尽量将这些预约安排在放学后或学校假期期间）

paragraphs.text: • An interview with a prospective employer or college
paragraphs.translation: • 与未来雇主或大学的面试

paragraphs.text: • Exceptional family circumstances, such as bereavement
paragraphs.translation: • 特殊的家庭情况，例如丧亲

paragraphs.text: • Days of religious observance.
paragraphs.translation: • 宗教节日。

paragraphs.text: Your child's school will not authorise absence for the following reasons:
paragraphs.translation: 您孩子的学校不会批准以下原因的缺勤：

paragraphs.text: • Shopping during school hours
paragraphs.translation: • 在上课时间购物

paragraphs.text: • Day trips
paragraphs.translation: • 一日游

paragraphs.text: • Holidays which have not been agreed
paragraphs.translation: • 未经同意的假期

paragraphs.text: • Birthdays
paragraphs.translation: • 生日

paragraphs.text: • Looking after brothers or sisters or ill relatives.
paragraphs.translation: • 照顾兄弟姐妹或生病的亲属。

paragraphs.text: HOLIDAY APARTMENTS TO LET
paragraphs.translation: 度假公寓待租

paragraphs.text: A

Sleeps 2-3. One-bedroom apartment with uninterrupted sea views. This is a small first floor apartment in a well-established apartment complex containing a range of leisure facilities and a supermarket for residents. On the edge of the town but close to cafes and restaurants. On-street parking is generally available.
paragraphs.translation:
可入住2-3人。
一居室公寓，拥有无遮挡海景。
这是一套小型一楼公寓，位于设施完善的公寓综合体内，内设一系列休闲设施和供居民使用的超市。
位于小镇边缘，但靠近咖啡馆和餐厅。
通常可在街边停车。
可供2人入住。

paragraphs.text: B

Sleeps 2-4. Spacious one-bedroom apartment in a complex that has only just opened, five minutes' walk from the sea. Private parking in front of building. It is located in a quiet, unspoilt village with a local market, banks, cafés and restaurants. There are some fabulous championship golf courses within easy walking distance.
paragraphs.translation:

A truly peaceful location in a picturesque village, but less than ten minutes' drive from the coast and all the amenities of a town. Owners live nearby and are happy to help in any way they can.

This great location offers easy access to all that this fantastic town has to offer, a few minutes' drive from its supermarket, bank, cafés, restaurants. The ferry to the island beach leaves from 100 m away. Ten minutes walk from the new shopping centre, which has many shops, food hall, cinema and multi-storey car park.

groups.instructions:
Questions 1 - 5
Do the following statements agree with the information given in Reading Passage 1?
Choose TRUE if the statement agrees with the information given in the text, choose FALSE if the statement contradicts the information, or choose NOT GIVEN if there is no information on this.

questions.prompt: Children must go to the school where they are registered.
questions.analysis: 题干中的“Children must go to the school where they are registered”与原文中的“The law says that parents must ensure that their child regularly attends the school where he/she is registered”意思一致。原文明确指出法律要求孩子必须就读于其注册的学校，因此该陈述为TRUE。
questions.reason: 题干与原文内容直接对应。
questions.location_analysis: 原文明确指出家长必须确保孩子就读于注册学校，与题干一致。
questions.paraphrasing: must attend registered school -> must ensure that their child regularly attends the school where he/she is registered
evidence: The law says that parents must ensure that their child regularly attends the school where he/she is registered.

wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文明确表示孩子必须去注册的学校，因此该选项与原文矛盾。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确给出了相关信息，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: All arrivals after the register has closed are recorded as 'unauthorised' absences.
questions.analysis: 题干称“所有在点名结束后到校的情况都会被记为‘未经授权’的缺勤”，但原文明确指出只有“在没有正当理由的情况下迟到”才会被记为‘unauthorised’ absence。题干忽略了“without a good reason”这一关键条件，表述过于绝对，因此答案为FALSE。
questions.reason: 原文有条件限制，题干忽略条件，故为FALSE。
questions.location_analysis: 题干说所有迟到都记为未经授权缺勤，原文强调无合理理由才如此记录，故题干过于绝对。
questions.paraphrasing: all arrivals after register closed -> if arrives after register closed without good reason, recorded as unauthorised
evidence: If your child arrives after the register has closed without a good reason, this will be recorded as an 'unauthorised' absence for that session.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 题干与原文信息矛盾，原文中并非所有迟到都记为“未经授权”的缺勤。
wrong_reasons.NOT GIVEN: 原文明确提到了相关情况，并非未提及。

questions.prompt: If your child is absent from school, you must send the school a letter to explain why.
questions.analysis: 题干提到“必须写信解释缺勤原因”，但原文仅说明家长“应尽快告知学校缺勤原因（preferably on the first morning of absence）”，并未限定必须通过书信形式。由于题干添加了原文未提及的具体方式，信息无法确认，故答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 题干提及必须写信，原文未提及，故无法判断。
questions.location_analysis: 原文要求告知学校原因，但未规定必须用信件，题干增加了原信息中没有的要求。
questions.paraphrasing: must send a letter -> it is vital that you let the school know why (no specified requirement for letter)
evidence: If your child has to miss school it is vital that you let the school know why, preferably on the first morning of absence.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文并未明确要求必须写信，题干说法无依据。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未提及不需要写信，题干否定缺乏证据。

questions.prompt: Staff who think a child is having difficulties at school will contact the parents.
questions.analysis: 题干说“学校工作人员会主动联系家长”，但原文说的是“If you know or think that your child is having difficulties attending school you should contact the school”，即家长应主动联系学校，而非学校联系家长。两者主语和动作方向相反，原文未提学校主动联系的情形，因此答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 原文未提及学校主动联系家长，因此题干未提及。
questions.location_analysis: 原文说的是家长应联系学校，题干说学校联系家长，方向相反。
questions.paraphrasing: school contacts parents -> you should contact the school (parents主动联系，非学校联系家长)
evidence: If you know or think that your child is having difficulties attending school you should contact the school.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文中未提及员工会联系家长的做法，因此无法判断为真。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文中并未否定员工联系家长的做法，因此不能判断为假。

questions.prompt: Schools will contact other authorities about children who take frequent unauthorised absences.
questions.analysis: 题干提到“学校会就频繁无故缺勤联系其他机构”，但原文仅说明学校会将无合理解释的缺勤记录为‘unauthorised’，并未提及是否会进一步联系其他当局。由于缺乏相关信息，无法判断该陈述是否成立，故答案为NOT GIVEN。
questions.reason: 未提及联系其他机构。
questions.location_analysis: 原文讨论了授权和未授权缺席，但未提及学校会联系其他机构，因此NOT GIVEN。
questions.paraphrasing: contact other authorities -> 原文未提
evidence: If your child is absent and the school either does not receive an explanation from you, or considers the explanation unsatisfactory, it will record your child's absence as 'unauthorised', that is, as truancy.

wrong_reasons.TRUE: 原文未提及学校会联系其他机构，该信息无中生有。
wrong_reasons.FALSE: 原文未明确否定这一说法，因此不能判断为错误。

paragraphs.text: We're looking for keen and effective people who are passionate about travel to work as Travel Sales Consultants in our rapidly-growing team. Our recruitment process has five stages. Here's how it works:
paragraphs.translation:
我们正在寻找对旅行充满热情、敏锐且高效的人才，加入我们快速发展的团队，担任旅行销售顾问。
我们的招聘流程分为五个阶段。
具体操作如下：

paragraphs.text: The first stage is to use our online application form to apply for a current vacancy. This is your chance to tell us about yourself, and the qualities and experience you have that make you the ideal person for the job. For the Travel Sales Consultant role, you'll need to provide us with evidence that you have extensive experience in a marketing environment, as well as a solid academic background. If you're interested in a career as a Corporate Travel Consultant, you'll need at least one year's experience as a Travel Consultant.
paragraphs.translation:
第一阶段是使用我们的在线申请表格来申请当前的职位空缺。
这是你向我们介绍自己、以及你拥有的使你成为该职位理想人选的素质和经验的机会。
对于旅行销售顾问这一职位，你需要向我们提供证据，证明你在市场营销环境中有丰富的经验，以及扎实的学术背景。
如果你对从事企业旅行顾问的职业感兴趣，你需要至少有一年的旅行顾问经验。

paragraphs.text: If you reach Stage Two, we'll arrange a telephone discussion, where you can find out more about us, including the rewards on offer. For instance, once a year we like to acknowledge outstanding efforts and celebrate successes with our co-workers, and we have prize-giving ceremonies designed to do just this.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你进入第二阶段，我们将安排一次电话沟通，届时你可以了解更多关于我们的信息，包括提供的奖励。
例如，我们每年都会与同事们一起表彰杰出贡献并庆祝成功，为此我们会举办颁奖典礼。

paragraphs.text: In Stage Three we'll be able to give you more information about GZJ Travel, and find out more about you, at an interview which you'll attend with a small group of other applicants. We'll be asking you about your ambitions and of course your sales ability, the most vital quality for our business. You'll also be required to complete a psychometric test so we can find out more about your working style and characteristics. We'll also tell you about some of the perks - for example, as a Flight Center employee you can take advantage of the free consultations conducted by our in-house health and wellbeing team, Healthwise.
paragraphs.translation:
在第三阶段，我们将能够提供更多关于GZJ旅游的信息，并在你与其他一小群申请人共同参加的面试中进一步了解你。
我们将询问你的抱负，当然还有你的销售能力，这是对我们业务至关重要的素质。
你还需要完成一项心理测试，以便我们进一步了解你的工作风格和特点。
我们还会告诉你一些额外福利——例如，作为Flight Center的员工，你可以享受由我们内部健康与福祉团队Healthwise提供的免费咨询。

paragraphs.text: Next, in Stage Four, you'll be introduced to the Area Leader and you'll also visit one of our shops, where you'll meet the team and find out more about the sort of work that's involved. If you successfully pass Stage Four, you've reached the final stage of the process and we'll be in touch with a job offer! And if you accept, we'll book you into our Learning Center to get your training under way as soon as possible. Careerwise, the department responsible for the training, will then organise individual coaching to assist in setting goals for your career path.
paragraphs.translation:
接下来，在第四阶段，您将被介绍给区域负责人，并且您还将参观我们的一家门店，在那里您将与团队会面，并进一步了解所涉及的工作类型。
如果您成功通过第四阶段，您就进入了流程的最后一个阶段，我们将与您联系并提供工作机会！
如果您接受，我们将为您预订学习中心，以便尽快开始您的培训。
负责培训的 Careerwise 部门随后将安排个人指导，以协助您为职业道路设定目标。

paragraphs.text: Health and safety in the workplace
paragraphs.translation: 工作场所的健康与安全

paragraphs.text: Personal safety
paragraphs.translation: 人身安全

paragraphs.text: You must be familiar with the emergency procedures in your building so that you know what to do in the event of fire, spillages or other accidents. Do not enter restricted areas without authorisation, and at all times observe the warnings given. Do not wedge open fire doors or tamper with door closures, and do not block doorways, corridors or stairs, as obstructions may affect access in the event of a fire. Avoid leaving drawers and doors open unnecessarily and do not trail cables or flexes across the floor.
paragraphs.translation:
你必须熟悉所在大楼的紧急程序，以便在发生火灾、泄漏或其他事故时知道该怎么做。
未经授权不得进入限制区域，并时刻遵守所给出的警告。
不要用楔子撑开防火门或擅自改动闭门器，也不要堵塞门口、走廊或楼梯，因为障碍物可能会影响火灾时的通道。
避免不必要地让抽屉和门保持打开状态，也不要将电缆或电线拖在地板上。

paragraphs.text: How to dispose of rubbish safely
paragraphs.translation: 如何安全处理垃圾

paragraphs.text: We aim to protect the environment by saving and recycling glass, waste paper, and an increasing range of other materials. It is important to check materials carefully for contamination before placing them in recycling containers. Never put sharp objects such as razor blades or broken glass into waste bins without having wrapped the items carefully to protect those emptying the bins. Other waste procedures may vary - contact your Building Manager or Divisional Safety Officer for advice with regard to your particular department.
paragraphs.translation:
我们旨在通过节约和回收玻璃、废纸以及越来越多其他种类的材料来保护环境。
在将材料放入回收容器之前，仔细检查是否有污染非常重要。
切勿将诸如剃须刀片或碎玻璃之类的尖锐物品直接放入垃圾桶，除非已仔细包裹好这些物品，以保护清空垃圾桶的人员。
其他垃圾处理程序可能有所不同——请联系你的楼宇经理或部门安全官员，以获取针对你特定部门的建议。

paragraphs.text: How to handle heavy objects
paragraphs.translation: 如何处理重物

paragraphs.text: Make sure that shelves are not overloaded and that glass and heavy objects are stored at working height where they will be easier to reach. Use steps or ladders to reach items at height; never climb on benches, tables or chairs. Never move anything that is beyond your capability. Wherever possible you should use the trolleys provided in the workplace to do the job for you. If repetitive manual operations are routine in your work, your department will ensure you receive appropriate instruction on safe working practices and posture.
paragraphs.translation:
确保货架不超载，并且玻璃和重物存放在工作高度，以便更容易拿取。
使用梯子或阶梯取高处物品；切勿攀爬长凳、桌子或椅子。
切勿移动超出自身能力范围的物品。
只要可能，应使用工作场所提供的手推车来完成搬运工作。
如果重复性体力操作是您工作中的常规内容，您的部门将确保您接受有关安全操作规程和姿势的适当指导。

paragraphs.text: Staying alert
paragraphs.translation: 保持警觉

paragraphs.text: If you become mentally or physically tired during the working day, and find that you're feeling drowsy or not concentrating properly, you could be at risk of causing an accident or making a mistake that could harm you or your colleagues. To prevent this, make sure that you take regular breaks when necessary.
paragraphs.translation:
如果你在工作日期间感到精神或身体疲惫，并且发现自己昏昏欲睡或注意力不集中，你就可能面临引发事故或犯错的风险，这些事故或错误可能伤害你或你的同事。
为防止这种情况，请确保在必要时定期休息。

sentence_translations.sentence: We're looking for keen and effective people who are passionate about travel to work as Travel Sales Consultants in our rapidly-growing team.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们正在寻找对旅行充满热情、敏锐且高效的人才，加入我们快速发展的团队，担任旅行销售顾问。

sentence_translations.sentence: Our recruitment process has five stages.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们的招聘流程分为五个阶段。

sentence_translations.sentence: Here's how it works:
sentence_translations.translation: 具体操作如下：

sentence_translations.sentence: The first stage is to use our online application form to apply for a current vacancy.
sentence_translations.translation: 第一阶段是使用我们的在线申请表格来申请当前的职位空缺。

sentence_translations.sentence: This is your chance to tell us about yourself, and the qualities and experience you have that make you the ideal person for the job.
sentence_translations.translation: 这是你向我们介绍自己、以及你拥有的使你成为该职位理想人选的素质和经验的机会。

sentence_translations.sentence: For the Travel Sales Consultant role, you'll need to provide us with evidence that you have extensive experience in a marketing environment, as well as a solid academic background.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于旅行销售顾问这一职位，你需要向我们提供证据，证明你在市场营销环境中有丰富的经验，以及扎实的学术背景。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you're interested in a career as a Corporate Travel Consultant, you'll need at least one year's experience as a Travel Consultant.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你对从事企业旅行顾问的职业感兴趣，你需要至少有一年的旅行顾问经验。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you reach Stage Two, we'll arrange a telephone discussion, where you can find out more about us, including the rewards on offer.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你进入第二阶段，我们将安排一次电话沟通，届时你可以了解更多关于我们的信息，包括提供的奖励。

sentence_translations.sentence: For instance, once a year we like to acknowledge outstanding efforts and celebrate successes with our co-workers, and we have prize-giving ceremonies designed to do just this.
sentence_translations.translation: 例如，我们每年都会与同事们一起表彰杰出贡献并庆祝成功，为此我们会举办颁奖典礼。

sentence_translations.sentence: In Stage Three we'll be able to give you more information about GZJ Travel, and find out more about you, at an interview which you'll attend with a small group of other applicants.
sentence_translations.translation: 在第三阶段，我们将能够提供更多关于GZJ旅游的信息，并在你与其他一小群申请人共同参加的面试中进一步了解你。

sentence_translations.sentence: We'll be asking you about your ambitions and of course your sales ability, the most vital quality for our business.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们将询问你的抱负，当然还有你的销售能力，这是对我们业务至关重要的素质。

sentence_translations.sentence: You'll also be required to complete a psychometric test so we can find out more about your working style and characteristics.
sentence_translations.translation: 你还需要完成一项心理测试，以便我们进一步了解你的工作风格和特点。

sentence_translations.sentence: We'll also tell you about some of the perks - for example, as a Flight Center employee you can take advantage of the free consultations conducted by our in-house health and wellbeing team, Healthwise.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们还会告诉你一些额外福利——例如，作为Flight Center的员工，你可以享受由我们内部健康与福祉团队Healthwise提供的免费咨询。

sentence_translations.sentence: Next, in Stage Four, you'll be introduced to the Area Leader and you'll also visit one of our shops, where you'll meet the team and find out more about the sort of work that's involved.
sentence_translations.translation: 接下来，在第四阶段，您将被介绍给区域负责人，并且您还将参观我们的一家门店，在那里您将与团队会面，并进一步了解所涉及的工作类型。

sentence_translations.sentence: If you successfully pass Stage Four, you've reached the final stage of the process and we'll be in touch with a job offer!
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您成功通过第四阶段，您就进入了流程的最后一个阶段，我们将与您联系并提供工作机会！

sentence_translations.sentence: And if you accept, we'll book you into our Learning Center to get your training under way as soon as possible.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果您接受，我们将为您预订学习中心，以便尽快开始您的培训。

sentence_translations.sentence: Careerwise, the department responsible for the training, will then organise individual coaching to assist in setting goals for your career path.
sentence_translations.translation: 负责培训的 Careerwise 部门随后将安排个人指导，以协助您为职业道路设定目标。

sentence_translations.sentence: Hilton Laboratory
sentence_translations.translation: 希尔顿实验室

sentence_translations.sentence: Health and safety in the workplace
sentence_translations.translation: 工作场所的健康与安全

sentence_translations.sentence: Personal safety
sentence_translations.translation: 人身安全

sentence_translations.sentence: You must be familiar with the emergency procedures in your building so that you know what to do in the event of fire, spillages or other accidents.
sentence_translations.translation: 你必须熟悉所在大楼的紧急程序，以便在发生火灾、泄漏或其他事故时知道该怎么做。

sentence_translations.sentence: Do not enter restricted areas without authorisation, and at all times observe the warnings given.
sentence_translations.translation: 未经授权不得进入限制区域，并时刻遵守所给出的警告。

sentence_translations.sentence: Do not wedge open fire doors or tamper with door closures, and do not block doorways, corridors or stairs, as obstructions may affect access in the event of a fire.
sentence_translations.translation: 不要用楔子撑开防火门或擅自改动闭门器，也不要堵塞门口、走廊或楼梯，因为障碍物可能会影响火灾时的通道。

sentence_translations.sentence: Avoid leaving drawers and doors open unnecessarily and do not trail cables or flexes across the floor.
sentence_translations.translation: 避免不必要地让抽屉和门保持打开状态，也不要将电缆或电线拖在地板上。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to dispose of rubbish safely
sentence_translations.translation: 如何安全处理垃圾

sentence_translations.sentence: We aim to protect the environment by saving and recycling glass, waste paper, and an increasing range of other materials.
sentence_translations.translation: 我们旨在通过节约和回收玻璃、废纸以及越来越多其他种类的材料来保护环境。

sentence_translations.sentence: It is important to check materials carefully for contamination before placing them in recycling containers.
sentence_translations.translation: 在将材料放入回收容器之前，仔细检查是否有污染非常重要。

sentence_translations.sentence: Never put sharp objects such as razor blades or broken glass into waste bins without having wrapped the items carefully to protect those emptying the bins.
sentence_translations.translation: 切勿将诸如剃须刀片或碎玻璃之类的尖锐物品直接放入垃圾桶，除非已仔细包裹好这些物品，以保护清空垃圾桶的人员。

sentence_translations.sentence: Other waste procedures may vary - contact your Building Manager or Divisional Safety Officer for advice with regard to your particular department.
sentence_translations.translation: 其他垃圾处理程序可能有所不同——请联系你的楼宇经理或部门安全官员，以获取针对你特定部门的建议。

sentence_translations.sentence: How to handle heavy objects
sentence_translations.translation: 如何处理重物

sentence_translations.sentence: Make sure that shelves are not overloaded and that glass and heavy objects are stored at working height where they will be easier to reach.
sentence_translations.translation: 确保货架不超载，并且玻璃和重物存放在工作高度，以便更容易拿取。

sentence_translations.sentence: Use steps or ladders to reach items at height; never climb on benches, tables or chairs.
sentence_translations.translation: 使用梯子或阶梯取高处物品；切勿攀爬长凳、桌子或椅子。

sentence_translations.sentence: Never move anything that is beyond your capability.
sentence_translations.translation: 切勿移动超出自身能力范围的物品。

sentence_translations.sentence: Wherever possible you should use the trolleys provided in the workplace to do the job for you.
sentence_translations.translation: 只要可能，应使用工作场所提供的手推车来完成搬运工作。

sentence_translations.sentence: If repetitive manual operations are routine in your work, your department will ensure you receive appropriate instruction on safe working practices and posture.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果重复性体力操作是您工作中的常规内容，您的部门将确保您接受有关安全操作规程和姿势的适当指导。

sentence_translations.sentence: Staying alert
sentence_translations.translation: 保持警觉

sentence_translations.sentence: If you become mentally or physically tired during the working day, and find that you're feeling drowsy or not concentrating properly, you could be at risk of causing an accident or making a mistake that could harm you or your colleagues.
sentence_translations.translation: 如果你在工作日期间感到精神或身体疲惫，并且发现自己昏昏欲睡或注意力不集中，你就可能面临引发事故或犯错的风险，这些事故或错误可能伤害你或你的同事。

sentence_translations.sentence: To prevent this, make sure that you take regular breaks when necessary.
sentence_translations.translation: 为防止这种情况，请确保在必要时定期休息。

parts.title: Passage 3
parts.article_title: The Zebras' long walk across Africa

paragraphs.text: James Gifford investigates some interesting new research into migration patterns of zebras living in Botswana in southern Africa
paragraphs.translation: 詹姆斯·吉福德研究了关于生活在非洲南部博茨瓦纳的斑马迁徙模式的一些有趣的新研究。

paragraphs.text: A

For any animal to travel over 270 km in Botswana partly across the sand and low bush terrain of the Kalahari Desert is a remarkable achievement. But to do so in 11 days and without any obvious motivation, as this zebra population does, is quite extraordinary. On average their journey involves an exhausting round-trip of 588 km - between the Makgadikgadi salt pan area and the Okavango river - making it second only to the great trek undertaken by the zebra herds in the Serengeti National Park. However, what is even more incredible still in my view is that until recently it was completely unheard of.
paragraphs.translation:
对于任何动物来说，在博茨瓦纳穿越卡拉哈里沙漠的部分沙地和低矮灌木地带，完成超过270公里的旅程都是一项了不起的成就。
但这个斑马种群在11天内完成这一旅程，且没有任何明显动机，这实属非同寻常。
平均而言，它们的旅程包括在马卡迪卡迪盐沼地区和奥卡万戈河之间往返588公里的艰辛跋涉，这仅次于塞伦盖蒂国家公园斑马群所进行的长途迁徙。
然而，在我看来，更令人难以置信的是，直到最近这一现象都完全不为人知。
对于任何动物来说，在博茨瓦纳穿越喀拉哈里沙漠的沙地和低矮灌木地带，行程超过270公里，都是一项了不起的成就。
但像这个斑马种群那样，在11天内完成这一旅程且没有任何明显动机，则相当非同寻常。
它们的旅程平均涉及马卡迪卡迪盐沼地区与奥卡万戈河之间588公里的疲惫往返路程，这使得其在规模上仅次于塞伦盖蒂国家公园斑马群进行的大迁徙。
然而，在我看来，更为不可思议的是，直到最近，这一迁徙现象完全未被人们所知。
对于任何动物来说，在博茨瓦纳穿越部分卡拉哈里沙漠的沙地和低矮灌木地形，行程超过270公里，都是一项了不起的成就。
但像这个斑马种群一样，在11天内完成这一旅程且没有任何明显动机，则相当非同寻常。
平均而言，它们的旅程包括在马卡迪卡迪盐沼地区和奥卡万戈河之间长达588公里的往返行程，这使其仅次于塞伦盖蒂国家公园斑马群所进行的伟大迁徙。
然而，在我看来，更令人难以置信的是，直到最近，这一现象还完全无人知晓。

paragraphs.text: B

Hattie Bartlam, a researcher, discovered this migration while she was tracking zebra groups, officially known as harems, by the Okavango river for her PhD. Each harem consists of a stallion and his seven or eight mares with juvenile foals. There is no loyalty between zebras beyond this social group, though harems often gather together into so-called herds. For her study, Hattie had planned to compare the small-scale movement patterns of 11 different zebra herds in the area.
paragraphs.translation:
研究员哈蒂·巴特拉姆在为她的博士论文追踪奥卡万戈河附近的斑马群（官方称为“妻妾群”）时，发现了这一迁徙现象。
每个妻妾群由一匹雄马及其七八匹雌马及幼驹组成。
斑马之间除了这一社会群体外没有忠诚可言，不过妻妾群常常聚集在一起形成所谓的马群。
为了她的研究，哈蒂原本计划比较该地区11个不同斑马群的小规模移动模式。

paragraphs.text: C

In December, when the annual rains had transformed the roads into rivers, Hattie was, therefore, more than a little surprised when she checked the data sent by the radio collars she fits to the zebras she is tracking to find that six of the harems were 270 km away on the edge of the Makgadikgadi, a huge mineral-rich area where salt has collected over the years as water evaporates in the heat. Then, when the last of the moisture from the rains had disappeared in May the following year, five of those harems came wearily back to the Okavango. This raised the question: why, despite a plentiful supply of food and water, were the zebras being drawn eastwards to the salt pans? Even more difficult to understand was what made six of the groups travel so far, while the other five remained by the Okavango.
paragraphs.translation:
12月，当每年的降雨将道路变成了河流时，哈蒂检查了她安装在追踪斑马身上的无线电项圈所传来的数据，发现六个斑马群已经到了270公里之外的马卡迪卡迪盐沼边缘，那是一个巨大的富含矿物质的地区，随着水分在高温下蒸发，盐分多年来逐渐堆积。因此，她远远不止是感到惊讶。
随后，在第二年5月雨水带来的最后一点湿气消失时，这些斑马群中的五个又疲惫不堪地回到了奥卡万戈河。
这引发了一个问题：为什么尽管食物和水源供应充足，斑马们还是被吸引向东前往盐沼？
更难理解的是，是什么让这六个斑马群长途跋涉，而其他五个则留在奥卡万戈河附近。
12月，当年度的降雨已将道路变成河流时，哈蒂检查了她追踪的斑马身上佩戴的无线电项圈发送的数据，发现其中六个斑马群已在270公里之外的马卡迪卡迪盐沼边缘，这是一个富含矿物质的广阔区域，多年来随着水分在高温下蒸发，盐分在此积聚，因此她感到非常惊讶。
然后，在次年5月，当雨水的最后一丝湿气消失时，其中五个斑马群疲惫地回到了奥卡万戈。
这引发了一个问题：尽管有充足的食物和水供应，为什么斑马会被吸引向东前往盐沼？

十二月，当每年的雨水将道路变成河流时，哈蒂检查了她追踪的斑马身上佩戴的无线电项圈发送的数据，发现其中六个斑马群位于270公里外的马卡迪卡迪边缘——一个富含矿物质的大型区域，多年来由于水分在高温下蒸发，盐分在此积聚。因此，她感到非常惊讶。
随后，在第二年五月，当雨水带来的最后一点湿气消失时，其中五个斑马群疲惫地返回了奥卡万戈。
这引发了一个问题：尽管食物和水供应充足，为什么斑马还是被吸引向东前往盐沼？

This discovery created quite a buzz in the research community. I decided to visit Hattie and she explained that a century ago the large number of Botswana's zebra and wildebeest herds and the resulting competition for grass made migration essential. One of the migration tracks went from the Okavango to Makgadikgadi. But in the late 1960s, giant fences were put up to stop foot and mouth and other diseases spreading between wildlife and domestic cattle. One of these went across the migration track. Though the animals could get round the obstacle, each leg of their journey would now be 200 km longer - an impossible distance given the lack of permanent water on the extended route. Even today, with the fence gone (it was taken down in 2004), there is dangerously little drinking water to support the zebras on the return journey to the Okavango.

parts.source_article_title: The Zebras' long walk across Africa

sentence_translations.sentence: James Gifford investigates some interesting new research into migration patterns of zebras living in Botswana in southern Africa
sentence_translations.translation: 詹姆斯·吉福德研究了关于生活在非洲南部博茨瓦纳的斑马迁徙模式的一些有趣的新研究。

sentence_translations.sentence: For any animal to travel over 270 km in Botswana partly across the sand and low bush terrain of the Kalahari Desert is a remarkable achievement.
sentence_translations.translation: 对于任何动物来说，在博茨瓦纳穿越卡拉哈里沙漠的部分沙地和低矮灌木地带，完成超过270公里的旅程都是一项了不起的成就。

sentence_translations.sentence: But to do so in 11 days and without any obvious motivation, as this zebra population does, is quite extraordinary.
sentence_translations.translation: 但这个斑马种群在11天内完成这一旅程，且没有任何明显动机，这实属非同寻常。

sentence_translations.sentence: On average their journey involves an exhausting round-trip of 588 km - between the Makgadikgadi salt pan area and the Okavango river - making it second only to the great trek undertaken by the zebra herds in the Serengeti National Park.
sentence_translations.translation: 平均而言，它们的旅程包括在马卡迪卡迪盐沼地区和奥卡万戈河之间往返588公里的艰辛跋涉，这仅次于塞伦盖蒂国家公园斑马群所进行的长途迁徙。

sentence_translations.sentence: However, what is even more incredible still in my view is that until recently it was completely unheard of.
sentence_translations.translation: 然而，在我看来，更令人难以置信的是，直到最近这一现象都完全不为人知。

sentence_translations.sentence: For her study, Hattie had planned to compare the small-scale movement patterns of 11 different zebra herds in the area.
sentence_translations.translation: 为了她的研究，哈蒂原本计划比较该地区11个不同斑马群的小规模移动模式。

sentence_translations.sentence: In December, when the annual rains had transformed the roads into rivers, Hattie was, therefore, more than a little surprised when she checked the data sent by the radio collars she fits to the zebras she is tracking to find that six of the harems were 270 km away on the edge of the Makgadikgadi, a huge mineral-rich area where salt has collected over the years as water evaporates in the heat.
